items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: I think I suggested to him to go to Willard Alexander... But no, he was already signed with Willard Alexander.

ctx.x: I think that he and his wife thought that they didn't need me. Because I suggested to him to go to... I think I suggested to him to go to Willard Alexander... But no, he was already signed with Willard Alexander. I take that back. He was already signed with him. And then I didn't... I would have not agreed, if I had kept him, to let Joe Carroll go. Because Joe Carroll was an asset to him. But he still...
What about the other saxophone player that came around after, James Moody? Was he an asset to Dizzy?
